name: forumflow
author: Taako
description: Discord forum help workflows with intake tracking, persistent staff controls, assignments, accepted answers, lifecycle tags, stale queues, metrics, and CSV exports.
install_msg: ForumFlow loaded. Use `[p]forumflow addforum` inside a forum post or provide a forum channel, then run `[p]forumflow settings`.
short: Solved help-forum workflows, assignments, tags, stale queues, and metrics.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores configured forum, log, role, thread, message, author, assignee, accepted-answer author, and staff actor IDs; workflow states; timestamps; and aggregate resolution metrics. Export files are generated on demand.
